worst_moment: "Units must match to make sense. For example, if you go 60 km in 1 hour, you can't use minutes. What unit should time be in to match km/h?" - the third time asking a question the student had already answered ('hours'), with a muddled example.
best_moment: "To match km/h with seconds, convert km/h to m/s. For example, 36 km/h is 10 m/s. Try converting 72 km/h to m/s." - a small anchor example that let the student get 20 m/s and 100 m on their own.
